links.launch_gate: n48 poly04 D5 and n49 local preflight attempt terminal; renewed checkpoint gate; new S3 prefix and output root empty; local 32 GiB child plus 2 GiB reserve admitted.

question: Does the published n49 poly00 D4 seed lift to an independently checked D5 codimension greater than its freshly enumerated two solutions when the frozen disk policy uses its actual 50 Boolean variables?

claims.text: An independently accepted D5 certificate whose checked codimension exceeds the freshly enumerated solution count certifies LFD >=6 for the exact named Boolean presentation.

arms.description: Stream and recheck D4 seed, enumerate exact solutions, run checkpoint-capable D5 producer and original independent checker.
Fresh exact count for identical retained input; require agreement with historical two before D5.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact deterministic algebra and counts; no runtime comparison. Different chunk sizes are covered by software fixtures.

positive.not_applicable_reason: No known degree-six detection control. The unchanged native worker passed nine real-cloud source/restore controls; this local placement uses the same manifest and a separate admission gate. Non-detection gives no upper bound.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Separate frozen export-guard controls reject corrupt state, wrong identities, existing output and insufficient capacity; local worker count-equality fixtures emit no LFD bound. No population arm inferred.

factors.name: input
factors.how: Exactly n49 poly00, a previously published accepted D4 seed. The previous local attempt stopped before data on a mistaken 49-variable disk policy; this version pins the correct 50 Boolean variables, field and subspace.

factors.name: instrument
factors.how: Exact checkpoint worker bundle, producer, guard, original checker and exact counter pinned by manifest.

factors.name: host
factors.how: One local host with a 32 GiB native child RLIMIT, 2 GiB admission reserve, one-at-a-time ownership locks and measured free memory. The source-derived 30,443,866,121-byte envelope is an estimate, not measured RSS or admission.

factors.name: order
factors.how: D4 streamed seed and independent recheck, fresh exact count, optional compatible restore and guard, D5 producer and original checker.

factors.name: stage
factors.how: Count and seed acceptance required before D5; no inference from incomplete later stages.

comparisons.threshold: Original checker accepts degree5 and fresh exhaustive count is strictly below checked codimension.

variable_ledger.aa_not_applicable: Deterministic exact certificates and enumeration; no timing comparison.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Exact named-input replay has no arm-dependent clock inference.

seed_derivation.note: Original frontier parameters reused; no new random inputs.

instance_sampling.rule: One named published accepted D4 seed, selected by existing n49 campaign order for a separate D5 resource condition; no population inference.

blinding.how: Exact inputs and prior campaign are visible; no population or timing inference.

power.note: Exact named-input verification, no population inference.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: One named local run with a 21600-second stage watchdog; no runtime estimate.

primary.name: accepted D5 codimension lower bound
primary.definition: nq only after original independent checker acceptance; absent if no accepted certificate.
primary.source: result.json certified_codimension_lower_bound only when status certificate_verified

secondary.name: exhaustive Boolean solution count
secondary.definition: Fresh count from the pinned native counter; no copied historical value is a new measurement.

placement.checkpoint_detail: Event-driven save after each seed chunk and completed closure round, plus export-ready state. Conditional S3 publication and full readback precede local prune. Startup and output are accounted under a 64 GiB run directory with a 512 MiB reserve; the host admission also reserves 2 GiB. No time-based checkpoint interval guarantee.

stopping_rules.rule: One named 21600-second local attempt, no automatic retry. Preserve every checkpoint and terminal outcome; stop on resource/checker/count failure, projection killing1, or export deferral. A later restore requires a separately reconciled launch receipt under the same frozen request/context.
Resource refusal, timeout, invalid certificate or counter failure is retained without an LFD inference.

Launch only after n48 poly04 local D5 and n49 poly00 preflight refusal are terminal, checkpoint gate and fresh owner/capacity checks pass, and the new S3 checkpoint prefix and output root are empty. No concurrent frontier launch.

invalidation_rules: Any source or binary hash mismatch prevents execution.
A failed independent checker prevents a claim from that stage.
A counter failure prevents a solution-count comparison.
Killing1 in an over-approximating quotient is not membership evidence in the true closure.
Missing later stages remain unknown, even if an earlier stage proves a smaller lower bound.
Deferred export or missing checkpoint/certificate carries no mathematical bound.
Restore request mismatch or unverified state prevents native launch.

decision_rule.text: At any accepted degree d, exact_count < checked_codimension establishes LFD>=d+1; reaching6 requires an accepted degree5 certificate and this strict inequality.

inputs: SHA-bound published n49 poly00 D4 certificate
outputs: Stage transcripts, exact count, independently checked D5 certificate or explicit inconclusive outcome, immutable S3 checkpoints and full-readback acknowledgments.

graphs: Per-instance D5 outcomes with unknown cells explicit; no runtime graph

inadmissible: Calling a killed constant a proved upper bound.
Calling native output certified before original checker acceptance.
Inferring LFD>=6 without accepted D5 map and strict count inequality.
Replacing original capped dense-engine records with cascade outcomes.
Treating a lower-degree accepted stage as degree-five completion.

literature.claim: Constructive quotient-lift rationale, source review and remaining validation requirements.
Allocation source review and qualified identical certificate operations. No novelty or performance claim.

amendments.reason: V1 was admitted but stopped before seed transfer because disk_policy.N was the curve parameter 49 rather than the certificate Boolean-variable count 2k=50. V1 has no D4 check, exact count or D5 closure data.
changes: Correct disk_policy.N to 50 while preserving the published seed, target, memory cap, chunk and decision rule.
Use new output root and S3 prefix; retain the V1 refusal as an immutable run record.
Add a launcher dimension and seed-size preflight before memory admission.
